name: Kanon
source: The second princess of Grand Yakumo and [url=/c25867]Himari's[/url] younger sister. Because her older sister is the Crown Princess she is not expected to carry the throne and has more freedom for whom she is to marry, however great expectations still weigh on her. [url=/c25870]Rara[/url] is her best friend and the two are often inseparable. She calls Akira Onii-chan.
